In reality, a wide spectrum of development levels might be possible, ranging from no development to extremely rapid mining of the coal. By choosing three very different scenarios from various points along this spectrum for close analysis, it is hoped that the reader will be able to understand the potential types of cause and effect relationships which will be created within the natural and cultural systems affected by these activities.
Low Level Development
